Stack.signature: Stack(children: any[], direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
Stack.description: Flex container. direction: "row"|"column" (default "column"). gap: "none"|"xs"|"s"|"m"|"l"|"xl"|"2xl" (default "m"). align: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"baseline". justify: "start"|"center"|"end"|"between"|"around"|"evenly".

Card.signature: Card(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | Tabs | Carousel | Stack)[], variant?: "card" | "sunk" | "clear", direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
Card.description: Styled container. variant: "card" (default, elevated) | "sunk" (recessed) | "clear" (transparent). Always full width. Accepts all Stack flex params (default: direction "column"). Cards flex to share space in row/wrap layouts.

CardHeader.description: Header with optional title and subtitle

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy".

Callout.signature: Callout(variant: "info" | "warning" | "error" | "success" | "neutral", title: string, description: string, visible?: $binding<boolean>)
Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TextCallout.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description

Table.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.

Col.description: Column definition — holds label + data array

BarChart.signature: BarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

LineChart.signature: LineChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
LineChart.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time

HorizontalBarChart.signature: HorizontalBarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
HorizontalBarChart.description: Horizontal bars; prefer when category labels are long or for ranked lists

PieChart.signature: PieChart(labels: string[], values: number[], variant?: "pie" | "donut", appearance?: "circular" | "semiCircular")
PieChart.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)

TabItem.signature: TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock)[])
TabItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components

AccordionItem.signature: AccordionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock)[])
AccordionItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is section title

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary", type?: "normal" | "destructive", size?: "extra-small" | "small" | "medium" | "large")

LessonHeader.signature: LessonHeader(title: string, subtitle: string, emoji: string, tag?: string, mood?: "forest" | "sun" | "lagoon" | "berry" | "clay" | "graphite", variant?: "question" | "numeral" | "spotlight" | "split", figure?: {value: string, caption?: string})
LessonHeader.description: Opens every lesson (always first child of root). variant: question (a 'why/how' title), numeral (one striking figure; also pass figure), spotlight (full colour fill, for 'what is…'), split (symbol/formula in emoji slot, e.g. 'CO₂', 'π'). mood sets the colour of the WHOLE lesson. Pass tag as "" if none.

BigIdea.description: The one-sentence core idea. variant: banner (tinted block), quote (large pull quote), sticky (sticky note). Root level only.

Predict.signature: Predict(question: string, options: string[], answer: number, reveal: string)
Predict.description: Pre-question BEFORE explaining, for topics with a famous wrong belief. The learner guesses; no guess is marked wrong; reveal explains. answer is the 0-based index of the right option.

Flow.signature: Flow(title: string, steps: {title: string, detail?: string}[], layout?: "rail" | "snake" | "cycle", center?: string)
Flow.description: A process in order, 3–6 steps, one-sentence details. layout: rail (steps with detail), snake (short causal chain), cycle (loops back; set center to the cycle's name). Root level only.

WorkedExample.signature: WorkedExample(problem: string, steps: {say: string, work?: string}[], answer?: string)
WorkedExample.description: A method solved step by step. Each step says what is being done (say) and optionally the working (work, e.g. a calculation). The last step is hidden until tapped. Root level only.

Compare.signature: Compare(left: {title: string, points?: string[]}, right: {title: string, points?: string[]}, verdict?: string, layout?: "split" | "versus" | "table", rows?: {label: string, left: string, right: string}[])
Compare.description: Two things to tell apart. layout: split (side by side), versus (opposites), table (3+ aspects: pass rows [{label,left,right}]). Root level only.

Analogy.signature: Analogy(concept: string, like: string, mappings: {a: string, b: string}[], breaks?: string)
Analogy.description: Explain something abstract by likening it to something familiar. mappings pairs parts of each (a = the concept's part, b = the familiar part). breaks says where the analogy fails. Root level only.

ConceptMap.signature: ConceptMap(title: string, center: string, nodes: {label: string, note?: string}[])
ConceptMap.description: A centre idea with 3–8 connected parts or causes that have no fixed order. Root level only.

Layers.signature: Layers(title: string, layers: {name: string, detail?: string, value?: string}[])
Layers.description: Parts stacked in their physical order, top to bottom (atmosphere, a network stack, soil). Root level only.

Timeline.signature: Timeline(events: {when: string, title: string, detail?: string}[], layout?: "vertical" | "track", title?: string)
Timeline.description: Dated events (3–6). layout: vertical, or track (many short events, scrolls sideways). Root level only.

StatGrid.signature: StatGrid(stats: {value: string, label: string, note?: string, pct?: number}[], layout?: "tiles" | "ribbon" | "rings")
StatGrid.description: 2–4 key figures (value like '23.7%', label, note = source/date). layout: tiles, ribbon (one full colour band), rings (shares of a whole; give pct 0-100 on each). Root level only.

Scale.signature: Scale(title: string, items: {label: string, value: number, display?: string, highlight?: boolean}[], unit?: string, log?: boolean)
Scale.description: Compare sizes that differ hugely on a log scale (planets, populations, speeds). items [{label, value (number), display (e.g. '8.8 billion'), highlight}]. Root level only.

RaceChart.signature: RaceChart(title: string, steps: string[], series: {name: string, values: number[]}[], unit?: string, source?: string)
RaceChart.description: ANIMATED bar chart race: bars re-rank as time moves (play/pause and a scrubber). Use for rankings or growth over time (largest economies, populations, company values). steps = the time labels in order (e.g. years, 6–14 of them); series = one per entity, with values[] the same length as steps (use real numbers from sources; label illustrations). Show up to 8 bars. Root level only.

Explorable.signature: Explorable(title: string, label: string, min: number, max: number, outcomes: {upTo: number, title?: string, text: string}[], unit?: string, step?: number, initial?: number)
Explorable.description: One slider the learner drags to see what changes. outcomes are bands in increasing upTo order, the last upTo >= max, each with a short text. Root level only.

Quiz.signature: Quiz(question: string, options: string[], answer: number, hint: string, explanation: string, variant?: "list" | "tiles" | "truefalse" | "cloze")
Quiz.description: ONE graded check. answer = 0-based index. hint nudges after a wrong try; explanation says why. variant: list (default), tiles, truefalse (options ["True","False"], answer 0 if true), cloze (question contains ___ for the gap).

Recall.signature: Recall(prompt: string, points: {text: string, key?: string}[])
Recall.description: Free recall check: the learner types what they remember, then compares to the key points. points [{text, key (the keyword to look for)}]. Alternative to Quiz.

FlipCards.signature: FlipCards(title: string, cards: {front: string, back: string}[])
FlipCards.description: 3–6 quiz cards: the learner thinks of the answer, taps to flip, then marks 'got it' or 'not yet' (front = question or term, back = answer). Alternative to Quiz.

MythFact.signature: MythFact(title: string, items: {myth: string, fact: string}[])
MythFact.description: Misconceptions corrected: 2–4 pairs, myth stated plainly then the fact. Alternative to Quiz.

PageTitle.signature: PageTitle(title: string, kicker?: string, emoji?: string)
PageTitle.description: Opens pages 2+ of a multi-page course lesson instead of LessonHeader (always first child of root there). kicker is a short label such as 'Page 2 · Try it'.

OpenQuestion.signature: OpenQuestion(question: string, modelAnswer: string, hint?: string, size?: "short" | "long")
OpenQuestion.description: The learner TYPES an answer in their own words and gets it marked by the tutor. modelAnswer = what a strong answer says (used for marking, shown afterwards). size: short (a sentence) or long (a paragraph). Use for 'explain why', 'what would you do', definitions, calculations.

PhotoAnswer.signature: PhotoAnswer(prompt: string, lookFor: string[], hint?: string)
PhotoAnswer.description: The learner answers with a PHOTO (a sketch, handwritten working, a diagram, something they made or found) and the tutor looks at it. lookFor = 2–4 things a good answer shows. Use when drawing or showing beats typing.

Simulation.signature: Simulation(title: string, intro: string, inputs: {key: string, label: string, min: number, max: number, step?: number, initial?: number, unit?: string}[], outputs: {label: string, formula: string, unit?: string, decimals?: number}[], chart?: {x: string, y: string}, insights?: {when: string, text: string}[])
Simulation.description: A live model the learner plays with: sliders change inputs and outputs recompute instantly. inputs [{key (identifier), label, min, max, step, initial, unit}]. outputs [{label, formula, unit, decimals}] where formula is arithmetic over input keys (+ - * / ^, parentheses, min, max, abs, sqrt, log, exp, round). chart (optional) plots one output across one input: {x: input key, y: output label}. insights [{when: condition like 'rate > 8', text}] appear while true. Use for anything with cause and effect you can calculate (interest, speed, dosage, pricing, physics).

SortGame.signature: SortGame(title: string, buckets: string[], items: {text: string, bucket: string}[], explain?: string)
SortGame.description: Game: the learner sorts 5–8 items into 2–3 buckets (tap an item, then a bucket), then checks. Each item's bucket must exactly match one bucket name. explain = one sentence after checking.

OrderGame.signature: OrderGame(title: string, items: string[], explain?: string)
OrderGame.description: Game: the learner puts 4–6 shuffled steps or events in the right order. items = the CORRECT order (the app shuffles). explain = why that order.

MatchGame.signature: MatchGame(title: string, pairs: {left: string, right: string}[])
MatchGame.description: Game: the learner matches 4–6 pairs (term ↔ meaning, cause ↔ effect, problem ↔ fix) against the clock.

Scenario.signature: Scenario(title: string, role: string, steps: {situation: string, choices: {label: string, outcome: string, score: number}[]}[], debrief: string)
Scenario.description: A role-play: the learner makes 2–4 decisions in a realistic situation and sees the consequences. role = who they are. steps [{situation, choices [{label, outcome, score: 0 (poor), 1 (okay) or 2 (best)}]}]. debrief = the lesson in one or two sentences. Great for work, money, health and people skills.

KeyTerms.description: 2–5 key words with plain meanings. variant: glossary or chips.

Takeaways.description: 2–4 short points to remember. variant: checklist or cards.

NextSteps.description: Ends the lesson: 2 prompts the learner can tap, written as they would ask. First applies the idea somewhere new, second goes deeper.

Stack.description: Flex container. direction: "row"|"column" (default "column"). gap: "none"|"xs"|"s"|"m"|"l"|"xl"|"2xl" (default "m"). align: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"baseline". justify: "start"|"center"|"end"|"between"|"around"|"evenly".

Card.description: Styled container. variant: "card" (default, elevated) | "sunk" (recessed) | "clear" (transparent). Always full width. Accepts all Stack flex params (default: direction "column"). Cards flex to share space in row/wrap layouts.

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy".

CardHeader.description: Header with optional title and subtitle

Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TextCallout.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description

PieChart.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)

BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

LineChart.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time

Table.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.

Col.description: Column definition — holds label + data array
